\[

\]
The component $P_av$ is the packet of $v$ selected by $a$. For a linear map $L:V\to V$, its transfer block from packet $a$ to packet $b$ is
\[
L_{ba}=P_bLP_a.
\]

\[
P_cMLP_a=\sum_{b\in A}(P_cMP_b)(P_bLP_a).
\]

\]
